## avisos

A feed of what changed in your MRs and agents, derived from successive MR listings and agent states, with no extra forge request.

Governs: `src/main/avisos.ts src/renderer/avisos/**`

- {**V1** When an MR listing completes after a previous one, Atril shall add, with the MR title as detail: «Te piden revisión» for an URL in Me toca revisar that was not there before; «Comentario nuevo» when the `notes` count of an MR in Mías or Me toca revisar is higher than before; «La CI falla» when an MR in Mías was known with a CI state other than «Falla» and is now «Falla»; «MR nueva en lo que sigues» for an URL in Sigo that was in no list before; «Has abierto una MR» for an URL in Mías that was in no list before; and «Ya no está abierta» for an URL that was in Mías and is now in no list. A forge with an error in either listing, or a list cut at its cap (`more`), shall produce no notice of «new» or «gone» for that forge's rows of that list. (The proof asserts each of the six kinds, one input that triggers none, the failed-forge rule and the capped-list rule.) src/main/avisos.test.ts listings}
- {**V2** The first listing after Atril starts with no stored baseline shall produce no notice. src/main/avisos.test.ts the}
- {**V3** When an agent enters «te necesita» — once per entry, where the needs-you Mac notification fires — Atril shall add «{branch} te necesita» linked to its workspace. src/main/avisos.test.ts an}
- {**V4** Atril shall keep the newest 200 notices — dropping the oldest, read or not — and the baseline in `$ATRIL_HOME/avisos.json` across restarts. src/main/avisos.test.ts notices}
- {**V5** The rail shall show «Avisos» with the number of unread stored notices when it is not zero; the screen shall list them newest first with kind, title and time, filter by kind, and «Marcar todo leído» shall clear the count. (The proof asserts the badge, the order, a filter hiding other kinds, and the count going to zero.) src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts the}
- {**V6** Opening a notice shall mark it read and open its MR view when the MR is in the latest listing (held app-wide, M9), otherwise say «Esta MR ya no está en la lista»; an agent notice shall open its workspace, or say «Ese trabajo ya no está» when it is gone. src/renderer/avisos/avisos.test.ts a}

## flow-status

Governs: `src/main/flow/** src/renderer/flow/**`

- {**F1** Where a change's the workspaces spec has no `## Verification criteria` heading, Atril shall show the stage Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts proposal}
- {**F2** Where it has `## Verification criteria` and no `## Approach`, Atril shall show Spec. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts criteria}
- {**F3** Where it has `## Approach` and its checklist holds no box, Atril shall show Plan. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts approach}
- {**F4** Where its checklist holds at least one open box, Atril shall show Construir with closed / total and the first open box. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts open}
- {**F5** Where every box is closed and the change folder still exists, Atril shall show Terminado sin aterrizar. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts all}
- {**F6** Where the workspace has `.agents/`, no change folder, and commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Aterrizado. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F7** The checklist reader shall ignore boxes inside a code fence, and in the workspaces spec boxes outside `## Checklist`. src/main/flow/checklist.test.ts fenced}
- {**F8** When a change's files change on disk, Atril shall update the stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts file}
- {**F9** If a workspace has no `.agents/` directory, then Atril shall show "sin Libretto". src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F10** Where the workspace has `.agents/` but no change folder and no commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts fresh}
- {**F11** When `.agents/` appears in a workspace that showed "sin Libretto", Atril shall show its stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts agents}
- {**F12** Where several change folders exist, Atril shall show the most recently modified one and list the others. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts several}
- {**F13** When the person clicks the Spec or Plan step (F29), Atril shall open a modal over the app with the current change's `proposal.md` (and, for Spec, one more file tab per `spec-*.md`), with the cursor at that part's heading — Spec: the first level-2 heading; Plan: `## Approach`, found outside code fences as in F1–F7 — and each shall be a button only from its stage on: Spec from Spec, Plan from Plan; Escape or Cerrar shall close it, asking first when there are unsaved changes. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts stage}
- {**F14** While a document is open with no unsaved changes, it shall show the file's new text within one second of the agent changing it, even when the stage does not change. src/main/flow/document.test.ts an}
- {**F15** While the agent's known state is working, the editor shall be read-only and its status bar shall say «solo lectura · Claude está escribiendo»; otherwise the person shall type into it, its file tab shall show a dot while there are unsaved changes, and ⌘S or Guardar shall save the whole file; if the save is refused, the person's text shall stay in the editor with the reason shown above it. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts edit}
- {**F16** If a save arrives while the agent's state read at that moment is working («Claude está escribiendo: no se ha guardado»), or names a change that is not a folder under `.agents/changes/` or a file other than `proposal.md` or `spec-<name>.md` directly in it («Ese archivo no se puede editar desde Atril»), or the file's mtime differs from the one it was read with («Claude ha cambiado el archivo mientras editabas: copia tu texto y vuelve a abrirlo»), then Atril shall write nothing and return that message; otherwise it shall replace the file atomically. src/main/flow/document.test.ts save}
- {**F17** The editor's colouring shall build headings, list markers, boxes, code and bold as React text nodes, so markup in the file (`<script>`, `<img onerror>`) shows as literal characters. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts markdown}
- {**F18** The change list shall contain every file that differs from the workspace's base commit — committed, uncommitted, and untracked-but-not-ignored — each with its status (A, M or D; a rename as D of the old path and A of the new) and its added and removed line counts (0 and 0 for a binary file, tracked or untracked). src/main/flow/changes.test.ts lists}
- {**F19** If the diff is asked for a path that is not in that workspace's change list, then Atril shall return no text without running any git command for that path. src/main/flow/changes.test.ts diff}
- {**F23** If a file's diff is longer than 1 MB (UTF-8 bytes), then Atril shall cut it at the last line break before 1 MB and end it with the line «Diff recortado a 1 MB». src/main/flow/changes.test.ts a}
- {**F24** Atril shall pass every listed name to git as a literal path (no glob or `:(` magic), and shall count an untracked symbolic link as one line without opening its target. src/main/flow/changes.test.ts names}
- {**F20** The Libretto panel shall show no «Cambios» section, no list of the branch's files and no «ver N archivos» button. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts the}
- {**F21** A box's code shall be seen only in the panel (F38) and large in the centre (F39); no diff modal shall open from the panel. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F22** While the stage is Construir or later, Atril shall ask for the boxes (F36) every 3 seconds, skipping a tick while the previous request has not answered, and keep a slower answer for the same workspace, box and file instead of dropping it. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F25** While the branch totals more than the hook's threshold (400), the top of the Libretto panel shall show a warning element (class `fbig`) reading «⚠ N líneas: rama grande (más de 400). Atril le ha pedido a Claude que te proponga separarla en MRs más pequeñas.» src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts a}
- {**F26** In an automatic workspace, Spec and Plan shall open read-only whatever the agent's state (an exception to F15; the large code view already is), with the status bar «solo lectura · modo automático» in place of F15's. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts automatic}
- {**F27** While the selected workspace has subagent entries, the panel shall show them as branches under the current box of the timeline (F38) — or under the «Cambio» line when there is no current box, or under a «Subagentes» line at the top of the panel when there is no change — newest `startedAt` first, each a button labelled with its description (or its type), its type when a description is shown, a live dot while it runs or «✓» when it ended, and «{d}» (F27's durations, refreshed every second while any runs), its accessible name ending in «trabajando · {d}» or «terminado · {d}»; no «Subagentes» section shall show. One test holds a case per clause. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts subagents}
- {**F28** When a subagent branch (F27) is pressed, the panel shall open a modal titled with its description (or its type), showing its type and «trabajando · {d}» or «terminado · {d}», and its log as monospace text: `> ` before the prompt, `⏺ ` before text and tool lines, `⎿ ` before the first result line, «✻ Pensando…» for thinking, and «Sin registro de este subagente» when the log is empty; continuation lines of a line carry no prefix; while the subagent has no `endedAt` the panel shall ask for the log again every second, and once more when `endedAt` arrives, then stop; when the entry leaves the list the modal shall close; Escape or «Cerrar» shall close it and return focus to the branch. The proof drives the polling with fake timers. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts a}
- {**F29** While the selected workspace has a Libretto change, the centre of Trabajo shall show, above the workspace's repo and title, six segments named Entrada, Spec, Plan, Construir, Revisar and Aterrizar — done ones full, the current one filled closed/total of its checklist with «{closed}/{total}» after its name, pending ones empty — where Spec and Plan are buttons as F13 makes them; and while F25's total applies, its warning line at the top of the panel. The Libretto panel shall not show the stages. src/renderer/flow/panel.test.ts the}
- {**F30** The Libretto panel shall have no foldable sections. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts the}
- {**F31** The Libretto panel shall show no list of the branch's files and no «+{n} más» files button. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts the}
- {**F32** The Spec and Plan steps (F29) shall be buttons named «Spec» and «Plan» with a document icon, each only from the stage F13 makes it a button on, opening the same document; the panel's «Cambio» line shall carry no document buttons. src/renderer/flow/panel.test.ts the}
- {**F33** The Libretto panel shall show no QA section; QA lives in its own screen (W113). src/renderer/flow/qa.test.ts the}
- {**F34** The Libretto panel shall show no text with «$», «≈» or «tokens» for the selected workspace. src/renderer/flow/cost.test.ts the}
- {**F35** While the flow state's `others` is not empty, the panel shall show «{n} cambios más en este repo» (n its length; «1 cambio más en este repo» for one) with a button «Ver en Libretto» that stores that workspace's repo as the Libretto repo (W104) and opens the Libretto screen, and no list of their names; with `others` empty, it shall show neither. src/renderer/flow/panel.test.ts other}
- {**F36** Main shall split a workspace's commits since its base by the commits that turn checklist boxes of its current change (proposal or `tasks.md`, as `readChecklist` finds it) from `[ ]` to `[x]`, returning per box its index in the current checklist, text, state (closed, current = the first open box, pending) and, for closed and current boxes, the files changed in its range with +/− counts and the closing commit's short id — closed: from the previous closing commit (or the base) to its own; current: from the last closing commit (or the base) to the working tree, uncommitted changes included — and the branch's total added plus removed lines; a box is matched across commits by its text; a box marked but not committed shows closed with the current range; boxes closed in one commit share its range; paths under `.agents/` are left out; with no change folder or no checklist it shall return no boxes. One test holds a case per clause. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts each}
- {**F37** When the window asks the diff of a box's file, main shall answer the diff of that file over that box's range as text, with F23's cut and F24's literal paths, and an empty string for a file outside the range. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F38** While the stage is Construir or later and there is a checklist, the panel shall show it as a timeline: closed boxes folded, each a button that opens its files and diff; the current box open with its files and the diff of its first file; the first 3 pending boxes greyed and «+{n} más» for the rest; the timeline asked again every 3 seconds while it shows, skipping a tick while one is pending. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F39** When the person presses «⤢ Ampliar» on a box's code, the centre shall show that box's files and the chosen file's diff as text in place of the terminal, which stays mounted but hidden, with «Volver al terminal ⌘⇧E»; pressing it shall bring the terminal back with its focus. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F40** Trabajo → Ampliar código (⌘⇧E) shall open the current box's code as F39 and, pressed again, close it; Escape in the large view shall close it and not reach the terminal; the menu item shall be disabled unless Trabajo shows «Uno» with a workspace selected. src/renderer/flow/boxes.test.ts the}
- {**F41** Each time the pointer enters a branch or the branch takes focus (both together counting as one entry), the panel shall ask that subagent's log once and show its last non-empty line without its F28 prefix (`⏺ `, `⎿ `, `> `), or «Pensando…» for a thinking line, in place of the description until the pointer leaves or focus moves; an answer arriving after that is ignored; an empty log keeps the description. src/renderer/flow/subagents.test.ts a}
- {**F42** When `boxDiff` is asked for a file of a box closed by a commit and the plan key is unchanged since the last `boxRanges`, the flow shall run exactly two git commands: one reading `HEAD` and the file's diff over that range — no `log`, `show` or listing. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F43** When `boxRanges` is asked again with the plan key unchanged, the flow shall run no `git log`, no `git show` and no listing of a range closed by a commit; the whole branch and every range without a commit are listed again, so an uncommitted edit shows on the next read. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F44** When `HEAD`, the base commit, or the checklist file's path, mtime or size changes, the next `boxRanges` or `boxDiff` shall plan again; closing or forgetting a workspace drops its cached plans. src/main/flow/boxes.test.ts a}
- {**F45** The diff shown for a box's file, small or large, shall leave out git's header lines — `diff --git`, `index`, `new file mode`, `deleted file mode`, `similarity`, `rename from`/`rename to`, `---` and `+++` before the first `@@` — and keep every `@@`, added, removed and context line in order, coloured as added or removed even when it starts with `---` or `+++`; a diff with no hunk (a pure rename, a mode change, a binary file) keeps its informative lines. src/renderer/flow/difftext.test.ts a}

## mr

The MR screen: your merge requests on GitHub and GitLab, the ones you review, and the ones in the projects you follow. Phase 2 of Atril; scores, threads and notifications build on it.

Governs: `src/main/forge/mrs.ts src/main/forge/scores.ts src/main/forge/threads.ts src/main/forge/lenses.ts src/main/forge/openmr.ts src/main/forge/linecomments.ts src/renderer/mr/**`

- {**M1** When the lists load, Atril shall put in **Mías** the open MRs you authored, in **Me toca revisar** the open MRs where your review is requested, and in **Sigo** other people's open MRs in your followed projects. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts lists}
- {**M2** An MR that belongs to an earlier list shall not repeat in a later one (order: Mías, Me toca revisar, Sigo). src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts an}
- {**M3** Each row shall show the title, the project, the author, the CI state, the size — «+added −removed · N archivos» on GitHub, «N archivos» on GitLab — and the age («hace 3 h», «hace 2 d»). src/renderer/mr/mrs.test.ts the}
- {**M4** The CI state shall be «Falla» for GitHub check-run conclusions failure, timed_out, cancelled or action_required and GitLab pipelines failed or canceled; «En curso» for check runs queued or in progress and pipelines running, pending, created, preparing, waiting_for_resource or scheduled; «Pasa» when every check run concluded success, neutral or skipped and for pipelines success, skipped or manual; and «Sin CI» with no check runs or no pipeline. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts ci}
- {**M5** When the person activates a row, Atril shall open the MR view (M23); the view's «Abrir en {forge}» shall open that MR in the browser. src/renderer/mr/threads.test.ts a}
- {**M6** If one of a forge's requests fails, then the screen shall keep every MR that forge did return and the other forge's MRs, and show above the sections, per failed forge, its W150 problem with «No puedo enseñarte tus MRs de {forge}.» under it, its button («Volver a comprobar» loads again; «Abrir Ajustes» opens Ajustes) and the detail folded; while any forge failed, an empty section shows no «Ninguna MR.». src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts one}
- {**M7** While no forge is connected the screen shall say «Conecta GitHub o GitLab en Ajustes» with a button that opens Ajustes. src/renderer/mr/mrs.test.ts no}
- {**M8** Atril shall follow per forge the 10 followed projects with the most recent activity, cut each list at 50 rows with «Hay más: ábrelas en {forge}» when more existed, and fetch at most 60 MR details per forge and refresh. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts caps}
- {**M9** Atril shall load the lists when it starts, every 5 minutes, when the MR screen opens and on «Actualizar», and the rail shall show the «MR» entry with the number of MRs in «Me toca revisar» from the latest load whenever it is not zero. src/renderer/mr/mrs.test.ts the}
- {**M10** Atril shall measure from the diff alone the added and removed lines (header lines excluded), the files, whether a test file changed — a path segment `test`, `tests`, `spec`, `specs` or `__tests__`, or a name `*.test.*`, `*.spec.*` or `*_test.*` ignoring case, or `*Test.{php,java,kt,cs}` with a capital T, so `latest.ts` and `latest.php` are not one — and a size of S below 100 changed lines, M below 400, L below 1000 and XL from 1000. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts metrics}
- {**M11** When an MR is scored, Atril shall run `claude` with exactly `-p --model sonnet --output-format json --tools "" --no-session-persistence --json-schema <schema>` and an instruction that names the person's language, send the diff on stdin — cut at 120 KB (UTF-8 bytes) at the last file boundary before it, with a line telling Claude it was cut — and take difficulty, risk, what, why and where from `structured_output`. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts scoring}
- {**M16** If the diff cannot be fetched, then Atril shall show «No se ha podido traer el diff: {detail}» with M6's texts as the detail (and «es demasiado grande para {forge}» on GitHub's 406); if Claude exits non-zero, runs past 180 s (then it is killed) or answers outside the schema, Atril shall show «Claude no ha podido puntuar esta MR ({detail})» with the exit code, «tiempo agotado» or «respuesta fuera del esquema» — never its output — and in both cases store nothing. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts failures}
- {**M12** Only rows in Mías and Me toca revisar shall offer Puntuar. src/renderer/mr/scores.test.ts only}
- {**M17** Main shall score only an URL that is in Mías or Me toca revisar of its latest listing, checked when asked; anything else shall be refused without fetching or running anything. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts only}
- {**M13** A score shall be stored with the head commit of the diff it scored; asking again for that commit shall not run Claude, and a row whose listed head commit is known and differs shall show the stored score as «De un commit anterior» with Puntuar de nuevo. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts a}
- {**M14** Atril shall run at most one score at a time, the rest in the order asked; asking again for an URL already queued or running shall return that same run. src/main/forge/scores.test.ts scores}
- {**M15** The score view shall show the measured values first, then Claude's, and when the diff was cut say «Claude vio {seen} de {total} KB»; each row's state shall read «En cola», «Puntuando…», its chips, or an error. src/renderer/mr/scores.test.ts the}
- {**M18** When the MR view opens, Atril shall show its threads, comments oldest first: on GitHub, review comments (`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments`) grouped by their root (`in_reply_to_id`), each carrying `path`, `line` (else `original_line`) and the last line of `diff_hunk`, and the general comments (`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/comments`) as one «General» thread; on GitLab, discussions (`GET /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/discussions`) without system notes, positioned ones carrying `new_path` (else `old_path`) and `new_line` (else `old_line`), the individual notes together as one «General» thread, and a thread resolved when every resolvable note in it is resolved. A thread with a file but no line shall show as a file thread. src/main/forge/threads.test.ts threads}
- {**M19** Atril shall fetch at most 3 pages of 100 items per endpoint; when more exist it shall say «Hay más en {forge}: “Te toca responder” puede estar incompleto». src/main/forge/threads.test.ts threads}
- {**M20** A thread shall be marked «Te toca responder» when its last comment is not yours and either you wrote an earlier comment in it or you authored the MR (the author taken from the listing). src/main/forge/threads.test.ts your}
- {**M24** The MR view's header shall show how many threads are marked «Te toca responder». src/renderer/mr/threads.test.ts a}
- {**M21** When the person writes a reply and clicks Enviar, Atril shall post it once — GitHub `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments/{root}/replies` for a review thread and `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/comments` for «General»; GitLab `POST /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/discussions/:id/notes` for a discussion and `POST /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/notes` for «General» — then show it in the thread; an empty reply shall not be sent, and a failure shall keep the text in the box with M6's message. src/main/forge/threads.test.ts a}
- {**M22** If the MR is not in main's latest listing, then reading or posting its threads shall be refused without a request, the view saying «Esta MR ya no está en la lista: actualiza» and keeping any written text. src/main/forge/threads.test.ts only}
- {**M23** The MR view shall show the threads as text (markup in a comment shows literally), and close with Escape — asking first when a reply box has unsent text. src/renderer/mr/threads.test.ts a}
- {**M25** When the person clicks Revisar con Libretto on an MR in Mías or Me toca revisar, Atril shall run `claude` exactly as M11 (no tools, no session, the diff on stdin cut at 120 KB) with a schema of at most 12 findings `{ lens: intent|security|design|reliability|tests, severity: high|medium|low, file?, line?, text ≤ 400 }`; a reply outside the schema, a fetch failure or a timeout shall show «Claude no ha podido revisar esta MR: {detail}» (M16's details) and store nothing; zero findings is an answer and shows «Libretto no ha encontrado nada que comentar». An URL outside those two lists of the latest listing shall be refused without a request (M17's text). Reviews and scores share one runner, one at a time in the order asked, keyed by kind and URL (M14 per kind). src/main/forge/lenses.test.ts the}
- {**M26** Drafts shall be stored per MR and head commit (no known head: the review is refused before Claude runs, «No se sabe el último commit de esta MR: actualiza»); while drafts exist for the current head the button is not offered; on a newer head the list shows «De un commit anterior» with «Revisar de nuevo», whose result replaces every draft. src/main/forge/lenses.test.ts drafts}
- {**M27** When the person clicks Publicar on an open draft, Atril shall publish it once — on its line as M36 says, or as the MR's general comment (M21) «**{lens} · {severity}** — `{file}:{line}`» (the location part dropped when `file` is absent, `:{line}` when `line` is), a blank line, then the text as written, as M37 says — then mark it published. A failure shall keep it open with M6's message. Publishing, sending or discarding a draft that is not open, or of an MR outside the latest listing, shall be refused without a request. src/main/forge/lenses.test.ts a}
- {**M28** Main shall offer Mandar al agente for an MR only when exactly one workspace is alive, on the MR's branch, in a repo whose `origin` remote names the MR's host and project; sending shall type, as N3, «Revisión de Libretto ({lens}, {severity}) en {location}: {text}» (location as M27, «la MR» when absent), mark the draft sent on `sent`, and on `gone` or `ignored` keep it open with N3's message. src/main/forge/lenses.test.ts a}
- {**M29** The MR view shall show each draft as text, with Publicar, Mandar al agente (only when main offers it) and Descartar while open, and «Publicado» (followed by its note when it has one, M37) or «Enviado al agente» with no actions after; Descartar removes it. src/renderer/mr/lenses.test.ts drafts}
- {**M30** When the window asks `atril:mr:fixCi(url)` for an MR whose CI is «Falla» and M28 finds exactly one workspace for it, main shall type into that workspace's pane, as literal text followed by Enter, «La CI de {url} falla. Mira qué ha fallado con {gh pr checks|glab ci view}, arréglalo y avísame antes de subir nada.» (gh for GitHub, glab for GitLab) and answer `{ sent: branch }`, judging the CI from main's latest MR listing; otherwise it shall type nothing and answer `{ error }` with «La CI de esta MR ya no falla.», «No hay un único trabajo de esta MR abierto en Atril.» or «No se pudo enviar: ese trabajo ya no está.»; a second call for the same MR while one is in flight shall be refused. One test holds a case per clause (GitHub, GitLab, two agents, CI not failing, gone, double call). src/main/forge/fixci.test.ts fix}
- {**M31** While an MR's CI is «Falla» and main reports an agent for it, the MR view shall show «Arreglar CI con Claude» beside the CI state; pressing it shall show «Enviado a {rama}» or the error; with no agent, or any other CI state, no button shall show. One test holds the visibility, the sent text and the error. src/renderer/mr/fixci.test.ts the}
- {**M32** When the MR view opens, the window shall ask `atril:mr:ciAgent(url)`, and main shall answer the branch of the one workspace M28 finds when main's latest listing has that MR's CI as «Falla», and `null` otherwise. src/main/forge/fixci.test.ts ci}
- {**M33** When the window asks `atril:mr:workFor(url)` for an MR in main's latest listing, main shall answer `{ kind: 'continue' }` for an MR in Mías and `{ kind: 'review' }` otherwise (Me toca revisar or Sigo) — or `{ kind: 'existing', workspaceId }` when a record of that same kind (review session or workspace) has that MR's branch in a matching repo, live or not — or `{ kind: 'none', reason }` with «Añade el repo de {proyecto} en Ajustes» when no registered repo has a remote naming the project and «Varios repos registrados son de {proyecto}» when several do. One test holds a case per clause. src/main/forge/openmr.test.ts an}
- {**M34** When the person opens an MR as review, main shall start a review session (W90) in the matching repo's folder with the single prompt element «/libretto:libretto-review <url>»; as continue, it shall open a workspace on the MR's branch fetched from the matching remote (W89) and start the single prompt element «/libretto:libretto-flow», refusing an in-place repo with «Este repo trabaja en tu copia: cambia de rama a mano»; a failed fetch shall answer «No se pudo traer la rama: {detalle}»; a URL that is not https, holds a NUL or starts with «-» shall start nothing. One test holds a case per clause. src/main/forge/openmr.test.ts an}
- {**M35** The MR view shall show «Revisar en Atril», «Seguir en Atril», «Ir al trabajo» or the `none` reason with a link to Ajustes → Repos, as M33 answers, beside M25's «Revisar con Libretto»; pressing a button shall end on Trabajo with that workspace selected (a dead one shows as stopped), or show the error in the view. One test holds a case per clause. src/renderer/mr/openmr.test.ts the}
- {**M36** When the person publishes an open draft that has `file` and `line` and the drafts are not stale, Atril shall post it once as a line comment — GitHub `pulls/{n}/comments` with `commit_id` the drafts' head, `path`, `line` and `side: "RIGHT"`; GitLab a discussion with a text position of the MR's `base_sha`, `start_sha`, `head_sha`, `new_path` and `new_line` — whose body is «**{lens} · {severity}**», a blank line and the text; and mark the draft published; before that post it shall read the MR from the forge (GitHub `pulls/{n}` head, GitLab `merge_requests/{iid}` `diff_refs`), keeping the draft open with M6's message if that read fails. One test holds GitHub and GitLab, a case per clause. src/main/forge/linecomments.test.ts a}
- {**M37** If the forge's head differs from the drafts' head, or the draft has no `file` or `line`, Atril shall post M27's general comment instead, once, with no note; if the line post answers 400 or 422, it shall post the general comment once and store the note «Publicado como comentario general: la forja no aceptó esa línea»; any other failure of the line post shall keep the draft open with M6's message and post nothing else. One test holds a case per clause. src/main/forge/linecomments.test.ts a}
- {**M38** `statusText` and `networkText` shall return the W150 sentence, so a failure in threads, scores or line comments shows no status number nor exception name. src/main/forge/mrs.test.ts status}

## settings

Governs: `src/main/credentials/** src/renderer/settings/**`

- {**S1** When a token is saved, Atril shall store it encrypted with `safeStorage` in `~/.atril/secrets.bin`, and the file shall not contain the token in clear. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts saved}
- {**S2** If `safeStorage` encryption is unavailable, then Atril shall refuse to save and say why. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts refuses}
- {**S3** No IPC response, log line or file other than `secrets.bin` shall ever contain a saved token. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts token}
- {**S4** When the Jira token is saved, Atril shall check it with `/rest/api/3/myself` and show the account name, or the service's error without the token. src/main/credentials/check.test.ts check}
- {**S5** While a token is stored, its connection row shall show «Gestionar», whose body offers only Reemplazar and Borrar (and, for Jira, the board), never the token. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts saved}
- {**S6** If a feature needs a service with no token, it shall show "Conecta <servicio> en Ajustes" with a link to that card. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts missing}
- {**S7** When the person presses «Crear token en Atlassian», Atril shall open Atlassian's API token page in the default browser and nothing else. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts create}
- {**S8** While a Jira token is saved, the top bar shall show the account's avatar and display name from `/rest/api/3/myself`; the avatar is fetched by the main process and reaches the renderer as image data only, never with the token; clicking the chip opens Ajustes. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts top}
- {**S9** When the person searches and picks a board in Ajustes, Atril shall store its id and name, and show it on the Jira card. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts picks}
- {**S10** When the Jira token is replaced, Atril shall keep the picked board; when it is deleted, Atril shall forget the board too. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts board}
- {**S11** While Ajustes is shown, the Repos card shall list every registered repo with its id, its path and, when its health is `ok`, a mode select offering «Auto · <detected mode>», «Worktree» and «In-place»; choosing «Worktree» or «In-place» shall store it as the repo's mode (W4), choosing «Auto» shall clear it. src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts repos}
- {**S12** When the person adds a repo from the card and its id is taken, the card shall ask for another id and register it with the one given. src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts adding}
- {**S13** If the folder the person picks is not a git repository, then the card shall say «Esa carpeta no es un repositorio git.» and register nothing. src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts a}
- {**S14** While Ajustes is shown, the Idioma card shall offer Español, English and Sistema, show the stored choice selected — Sistema when none was made — and store a new choice when picked. src/renderer/settings/language.test.ts language}
- {**S15** When the person picks English, the window shall show Atril's own texts in English at once — the rail, Trabajo, Tareas, Ajustes and the Nueva tarea dialog — without a restart. src/renderer/settings/language.test.ts the}
- {**S16** Every literal key passed to `t()` or `translate()` in `src/` shall have an English entry, no key shall be a template literal, and the catalog shall hold no entry that no call uses. src/preload/i18n.test.ts every}
- {**S17** While the language is English, texts Atril did not write — Claude's words and the path, command or description inside an activity line, a Jira title, a file name, the detail inside an error — shall be shown exactly as they came. src/renderer/settings/language.test.ts claude}
- {**S19** Outside tests and the catalog, no string literal or JSX text in `src/` containing á, é, í, ó, ú, ñ, ü, ¿, ¡ or « shall reach the person without going through `t()` or `translate()`. (Ceiling named: a Spanish text with none of these letters is caught only by S15's screens or by reading.) src/preload/i18n.test.ts no}
- {**S20** When the person saves a GitHub token, or a GitLab `https://` address and token, Atril shall check it against the forge's `/user` and store it only on a 2xx answer, then show the account name and never the token; on any other status it shall show «{forge} ha rechazado el token ({status}). No se ha guardado.», on a network failure «No se ha podido conectar con {forge} ({detail}).», and for a GitLab address that is not `https://` «La dirección de GitLab debe empezar por https://» — storing nothing in all three. src/main/credentials/forge.test.ts a}
- {**S23** While Público is chosen, Crear shall stay disabled until the person ticks «Entiendo que cualquiera podrá verlo». src/renderer/settings/createrepo.test.ts a}
- {**S25** The forge status answers sent to the window shall carry `saved`, the account and the address, and nothing derived from the token. src/main/credentials/forge.test.ts forge}
- {**S26** While no forge is connected, the Crear repo dialog shall say «Conecta GitHub o GitLab en Ajustes» and keep Crear disabled; otherwise it shall offer only the connected forges, with «Clonar y añadir a Atril» unticked. src/renderer/settings/createrepo.test.ts the}
- {**S27** While the language is English, a line that is «Claude te necesita» or «Claude ha terminado», or starts with «Leyendo », «Editando », «Escribiendo », «Ejecutando », «Buscando », «Lanzando un subagente: », «Te pregunta: », «Claude dice: » or «Le has escrito: », or has the shape «✗ … falló», shall show that part in English and the rest unchanged; any other line shall show as it came. src/preload/i18n.test.ts hook}
- {**S28** While the language is English, the activity feed, the workspace rows and main's needs-you notification body shall show the hook's lines through S27. src/renderer/settings/language.test.ts claude}
- {**S29** While Ajustes is shown, a «Conexiones» section shall list Jira, GitHub and GitLab as rows, each with its name, its purpose line, its state («Cargando…», «Sin conectar», or «Conectado · {cuenta}» plus « · {sitio}» when a site is known) and one button with `aria-expanded` — «Conectar» when nothing is saved, «Gestionar» when it is — that folds and unfolds the row's body; no form shows until it is pressed. One test holds a case per clause. src/renderer/settings/connections.test.ts connections}
- {**S30** When the person presses Conectar (or Reemplazar), the row shall open three numbered steps — the create-token button with visible text naming what to create (Jira «un token de API de Atlassian», GitHub «con el permiso repo», GitLab «con el permiso api»), the fields (Jira: dirección, correo y token; GitLab: dirección y token; GitHub: token), and «Guardar y comprobar» — where «Guardar y comprobar» is disabled only while a check runs («Comprobando…») and, if a field is empty, says which next to that field without calling main. One test holds a case per clause. src/renderer/settings/connections.test.ts connect}
- {**S31** Ajustes shall group Conexiones and Repos in a left column and Apariencia and Idioma in a right one, and `.ajustes` shall show them side by side while the window is at least 1100 px wide and as one column, left first, below that. src/renderer/settings/connections.test.ts settings}
- {**S32** If the Jira check's request throws (an HTTP status or a malformed address keep their own sentences), then Ajustes shall say what failed by cause — host not found (`ENOTFOUND`, `EAI_AGAIN`): «No encuentro {host}.»; a certificate code (starting `CERT_`, `ERR_TLS_`, `SELF_SIGNED`, `UNABLE_TO_`, `DEPTH_ZERO`): «El certificado de {host} no es válido.»; a timeout: «Jira no ha respondido en 10 s.»; anything else: «No responde nada en {origin}.» — each followed by «Revisa la dirección: la de tu Jira suele ser https://tuempresa.atlassian.net.», never with the exception name in the sentence, and under a folded «Ver detalle» the code read from `err.cause.code` when it matches `^[A-Z0-9_]+$`, else the exception's name. src/main/credentials/check.test.ts network}
- {**S33** While `repos.json` is damaged (W148), the Repos card shall show «No puedo leer repos.json: está dañado. No puedo usar ni cambiar tus repos hasta que se arregle.» with its detail folded and «Mostrar en Finder», and shall not show «Aún no hay ninguno» nor «Añadir repo…». src/renderer/statefiles.test.ts the}
- {**S34** If checking a GitHub or GitLab token gets an HTTP error or throws, then Ajustes shall show the W150 sentence for that forge — with «No se ha guardado.» after it — and the code under a folded «Ver detalle», never an exception name in the sentence; no fix button shows in Ajustes, where «Guardar y comprobar» already checks again. Jira keeps S32. src/main/credentials/forge.test.ts a}
- {**S35** Each repo row shall offer «Quitar el repo»; a refusal shows under the row as a problem with «Cerrar aviso». src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts any}
- {**S36** A repo with health `missing` or `not-git` shall show «Carpeta no encontrada» or «No es un repo de git» instead of its mode select, and «Buscar la carpeta…». src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts a}

## work-inbox

Governs: `src/main/jira/** src/renderer/inbox/**`

- {**I1** When the inbox refreshes, Atril shall call `GET /rest/api/3/search/jql` once with the JQL in Constraints. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts queries}
- {**I2** When the API returns issues, Atril shall list each issue's key, summary, type and status. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts parses}
- {**I3** If no Jira token is saved, then the inbox shall show "Conecta Jira en Ajustes" with a link, and shall never ask for the token anywhere but Ajustes; a saved token the API rejects follows I29. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts inbox}
- {**I4** When the person starts a task whose project and component have no remembered repo, Atril shall ask for one and remember it for the next task of that project and component. src/main/jira/start.test.ts remembers}
- {**I5** When the dialog opens, Atril shall propose the issue key exactly as Jira gives it (`WEB-3535`) as the branch name. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I6** When Start is confirmed, Atril shall launch `claude` with the bundled Libretto plugin, its hooks and the prompt `/libretto:libretto-flow <KEY>` in the new workspace's agent session — the plugin-namespaced name observed in box 4, because the bare `/libretto-flow` exists only where Libretto is installed globally. src/main/jira/start.test.ts start}
- {**I7** If an issue key does not match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$`, then Atril shall refuse to start it. src/main/jira/start.test.ts refuses}
- {**I8** If the In Progress transition fails, then Atril shall keep the workspace and agent running and show the error. src/main/jira/start.test.ts transition}
- {**I9** While a workspace record carries a task's key, the inbox shall show that workspace instead of Start, also after a restart. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts task}
- {**I10** If the proposed branch already exists in the repo, or its worktree path exists, then the dialog shall say so and propose the key with the first free letter suffix: `B`, `C`, `D`… (`WEB-3535B`), as the team does. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I11** When the inbox shows tasks, Atril shall group them: status category `new` → Por empezar; `indeterminate` whose status name says in progress → En curso; any other `indeterminate` → En revisión y despliegue, folded by default. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts groups}
- {**I12** While the Trabajo screen is shown, the sidebar shall show the running work first and the Jira tasks only as a one-line summary of counts that opens the Tareas screen. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts sidebar}
- {**I13** When a board is picked, the inbox shall group the tasks by its columns, in the board's order, matching each task's status id to the column that lists it, every column unfolded; empty columns shall not appear. (One proof holds both promises: main computes the order and the filtering in one pass, and the test asserts both on one result.) src/main/jira/board.test.ts groups}
- {**I14** If a task's status is in no column of the picked board, then it shall go to «Fuera del tablero», after every column, folded. src/main/jira/board.test.ts tasks}
- {**I15** While no board is picked, the Tareas screen shall keep the status-category groups and show «Elige tu tablero en Ajustes para ver sus columnas» with a link to Ajustes. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts no}
- {**I16** If the board id is not a positive integer, then Atril shall refuse it before any request. src/main/jira/board.test.ts refuses}
- {**I17** While a board is picked, the sidebar summary shall count the first column's tasks as "por empezar" and the tasks of every other column as "en curso" («Fuera del tablero» counts in neither). src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts summary}
- {**I18** If reading the picked board fails, then the inbox shall fall back to the status-category groups and show «No puedo leer el tablero: {W150 sentence}» with the W150 detail folded. src/main/jira/board.test.ts board}
- {**I19** Whether or not a board is picked, the inbox shall list only issues from the search with `assignee = currentUser()`, and shall never request the board's own issues. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts only}
- {**I20** When the person clicks Empezar on a task whose project and component have a remembered repo and whose proposed branch is free, Atril shall start it without the dialog and without a `--model` flag. src/renderer/nextup.test.ts one}
- {**I21** When the person ⌥-clicks Empezar, or the project has no remembered repo, or the proposed branch is taken, Atril shall open the Start dialog. src/renderer/nextup.test.ts option}
- {**I22** When the person writes a task in «Nueva tarea», picks a repo and presses Empezar, Atril shall open a workspace on the shown branch with the chosen model, passing the text as the task with agent `claude`, and show it in Trabajo. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I23** While the dialog is «Nueva tarea» and the text is empty or only spaces, Empezar shall be disabled; in both dialogs the text area shall accept at most 2000 characters. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I25** If no repo is registered, then the dialog shall say «Añade un repo en Ajustes → Repos», offer «Ir a Ajustes» which closes the dialog and shows Ajustes, and Empezar shall be disabled. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I26** While Jira is not connected (I3), «Nueva tarea» shall still be shown and open the dialog. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I24** While the person has not edited the branch, the branch shall be the first five words of the text, a word being a run of `[a-z0-9]` after lower-casing and removing accents, joined by hyphens, at most 40 characters with no trailing hyphen («Añadir filtro de Laboratorios» → `anadir-filtro-de-laboratorios`; «fix: bug-in api, ya» → `fix-bug-in-api-ya`); once the person changes the field in any way, it shall stay as they left it. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts branch}
- {**I27** When the person starts from «Nuevo trabajo», Atril shall open the workspace with the text as its task when the text is not blank (as I22), and with no task — plain Claude — when it is blank; Empezar needs only a repo and a branch there. (One proof holds both: the test starts one with text and one without and checks each call.) src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts new}
- {**I29** While Jira is connected and reading the tasks fails (including a 401 or 403), Tareas shall show the W150 problem with «No puedo enseñarte tus tareas.» under it, its button («Volver a comprobar» reads again; «Abrir Ajustes» opens Ajustes) and the detail folded — never «Conecta Jira en Ajustes», which stays for Jira not connected. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts a}

## workspaces

Governs: `src/main/** src/preload/** src/renderer/** resources/** electron-builder.config.cjs build/** !src/main/jira/** !src/renderer/inbox/** !src/main/flow/** !src/renderer/flow/** !src/main/credentials/** !src/renderer/settings/** !src/main/forge/mrs.ts !src/renderer/mr/** !src/main/forge/scores.ts !src/main/forge/threads.ts !src/main/forge/lenses.ts !src/main/forge/openmr.ts !src/main/forge/linecomments.ts !src/main/avisos.ts !src/renderer/avisos/**`

- {**W1** When a repo is registered and none of the three signals is found, Atril shall set its mode to `worktree`. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W2** If the checkout holds a git-ignored file outside dependency, build and editor noise (`node_modules`, `vendor`, `dist`, `build`, `.cache`, `.next`, `coverage`, `tmp`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `.DS_Store`, `*.log`), then Atril shall set the mode to `in-place` and name that file as the reason. Only files count — entries of `git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard --directory` that do not end in `/`; ignored folders (build output, tool caches) are never a signal. Noise names match at any depth. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W3** If every `node_modules` and `vendor` directory, at any depth, together exceed 2 GB, then Atril shall set the mode to `in-place` and say so. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W4** Where the person has set a repo's mode, Atril shall use it instead of detection, across restarts. src/main/repos.test.ts person}
- {**W5** When a workspace opens in `worktree` mode, Atril shall run `git worktree add` at `~/.atril/wt/<repo>/<branch>` on a new branch. src/main/workspaces.test.ts creates}
- {**W6** If a branch name fails `git check-ref-format --branch` with «is not a valid branch name» in its stderr, then Atril shall refuse with ««{branch}» no es un nombre de rama válido» before running any other command. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W7** While an `in-place` repo has an open workspace, Atril shall refuse to open a second one in that repo with «{repo} trabaja en tu copia y ya tiene un trabajo abierto ({branch}).» and `fix: 'worktree'`. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W8** If the main checkout has uncommitted changes, then opening an `in-place` workspace shall refuse and change nothing, answering «Tu copia de {repo} tiene {n} cambios sin commitear en {branch}: no puedo pasarla a {new} sin mezclarlos.», with the first 20 lines of `git status --porcelain` and «Trabaja en tu copia: {reason}» as `detail`, and `fix: 'worktree'`. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W9** When an `in-place` workspace is closed, Atril shall check out the previous branch from its workspace record; if the branch has uncommitted changes, it shall refuse instead. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W10** If a worktree has uncommitted changes, then Atril shall refuse to remove it and change nothing, answering «{branch} tiene {changes} sin commitear: no lo cierro para no perderlos.» — `{changes}` being «1 cambio» or «{n} cambios» — with up to 20 `git status --porcelain` lines as `detail` and `fix: 'terminal'`; a clean worktree is removed with `git worktree remove` (never a recursive delete) and its agent session ended. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W11** When a workspace opens, Atril shall write its workspace record and start its agent in a tmux session named `atril-<workspace id>` with `remain-on-exit on`, recording the agent's pane id. src/main/tmux.test.ts starts}
- {**W12** When Atril starts, it shall show every workspace record, attach to its tmux session when one exists, and start no new agent; a record whose session is gone shows `stopped`. src/main/tmux.test.ts reattaches}
- {**W13** When the person splits a pane, Atril shall add a tmux pane to that session. src/main/tmux.test.ts split}
- {**W14** When a Claude hook reports a `Notification` event for a session, Atril shall set its agent state to `needs-you`. src/main/status.test.ts claude}
- {**W15** When a session enters `needs-you`, Atril shall show one macOS notification, and no other until the session leaves that state, except where W78 suppresses it. src/main/status.test.ts notifies}
- {**W16** If the agent's pane (by its recorded pane id) is dead or missing, Atril shall set the agent state to `stopped`; other panes of the session do not count. src/main/status.test.ts exited}
- {**W17** When the usage endpoint answers, Atril shall show the Claude 5 h and 7 d percentages and reset times it returns. src/main/usage.test.ts parses}
- {**W18** The OAuth token shall never appear in Atril's log, in any IPC message to the renderer, or in any file under `~/.atril/`; the runner shall not log the stdout of a command marked secret. src/main/usage.test.ts token}
- {**W20** If the usage cannot be read and there is no earlier good read, then the footer shall show one sentence per cause — no Claude Code session in the keychain or credentials unreadable, token rejected (401), too many requests (429), no network or no answer, any other status or an unreadable body — that names neither `api.anthropic.com` nor a status code; a button «Abrir Claude Code» for the keychain and token causes, which opens Terminal running `claude`, and «Volver a comprobar» for the rest, which reads the usage again; and the technical reason (the status code, or the failing step) only inside a folded «Ver detalle»; if opening Terminal fails, the footer shall show that reason in place of the sentence. - {**W141** When reopening a workspace is asked by id while its agent is stopped — no session, or a session whose recorded pane is dead (W16), which is ended first — and its folder exists, Atril shall start a tmux session with the same name in that folder running `agentArgv` with the record's model and effort, plus `--continue` only when a transcript is recorded for it (`transcripts/<session>`), leaving its auto marker as it is, store the new pane id, and answer the workspace as alive; with `more: true` the effort goes one level up (none or `medium` → `high`, `low` → `medium`, `high` → `xhigh`) and is stored. src/main/workspaces.test.ts a}
- {**W142** If reopening is asked for an unknown id, a workspace whose agent is not stopped, a folder that no longer exists, or `more: true` at `xhigh`, then Atril shall start nothing and answer — «Ese trabajo ya no existe», «Este trabajo ya está abierto.», «La carpeta de {branch} ya no existe.» with `fix: 'forget'`, «Ya está en el esfuerzo más alto.»; if tmux fails to start, it shall end any half-made session and answer «tmux no ha podido arrancar el agente.» with the message as `detail` and `fix: 'terminal'`. src/main/workspaces.test.ts reopening}
- {**W143** While the selected workspace's agent is stopped (dead session, or dead pane: the bar then sits above the terminal), the centre shall show «{branch} está parado: su sesión de tmux ya no existe (un reinicio o tmux cerrado).», «Su agente no sigue hasta que lo vuelvas a abrir.», a «Volver a abrir» button and, below `xhigh`, «Seguir con más esfuerzo»; the terminal tip shall not show; both buttons are disabled while a reopen runs, so a second click sends nothing; a refusal shows with `Problem`, its button as in W135. src/renderer/reopen.test.ts a}
- {**W149** If the terminal's tmux client has exited or its descriptor is closed, then typing, resizing or detaching that terminal shall do nothing and never throw, and an exited client shall be forgotten so nothing more is sent to it. src/main/pty.test.ts a}
- {**W144** If `workspaces.json` exists but cannot be read, is not JSON, its `workspaces` is not an array, or an entry lacks a string `id`, `path`, `branch` or `session`, then every path that writes it — opening, closing, forgetting, reopening, pausing and any other — shall create, delete or write nothing and answer «No puedo leer workspaces.json: está dañado. No abro ni cierro trabajos hasta que se arregle.» with the error (code or parse message) as `detail` and `fix: 'reveal'`; a missing file still reads as empty. src/main/state.test.ts a}
- {**W148** If `repos.json` exists but cannot be read, is not JSON, its `repos` is not an array, or an entry lacks a string `id` or `path`, then opening a workspace, adding a repo, changing a repo's mode and every other path that writes it shall create, delete or write nothing and answer «No puedo leer repos.json: está dañado. No puedo usar ni cambiar tus repos hasta que se arregle.» with the error as `detail` and `fix: 'reveal'`; a missing file still reads as empty. src/main/state.test.ts a}
- {**W145** While `workspaces.json` is damaged, the status poll and the workspace list shall not raise unhandled rejections, and the window's workspace list shall show W144's sentence, «Tus agentes siguen en tmux, pero no puedo enseñártelos.» and «Mostrar en Finder» instead of the empty state (W97's empty text stays for an undamaged empty list). A damaged `repos.json` alone leaves the workspace list as it is. src/main/status.test.ts a}
- {**W146** If the `mkdir` of the worktree's parent folder (before `git worktree add`) fails with `EACCES`, `EPERM` or `EROFS`, then opening shall answer «No puedo escribir en la carpeta de Atril ({home}).» with the code as `detail` and `fix: 'reveal'`, with nothing to undo; if writing the record fails after the session started, it shall end the session, remove the worktree it made and delete the branch it made, and answer the same sentence for those codes, or «No he podido guardar el trabajo.» for any other, with the code as `detail`. src/main/workspaces.test.ts a}
- {**W147** When the window asks to reveal `workspaces` or `repos`, main shall show that file (or Atril's folder if it is missing) in Finder; any other name reveals nothing. A problem with `fix: 'reveal'` shows «Mostrar en Finder» in the workspace row (as W135), the new-work and start dialogs (as W130) and the sidebar. src/main/state.test.ts reveal}
- {**W150** When a request to Jira, GitHub or GitLab gets an HTTP error or throws, `net-problem` shall answer one sentence naming the service — 401: «{service} ha rechazado tu token.»; 403: «{service} no te deja ver esto con ese token.»; 404: «{service} no encuentra esa dirección.»; 429: «{service} pide esperar: demasiadas consultas.»; 500–599: «{service} está fallando ahora mismo.»; any other status: «{service} ha contestado algo que no esperaba.»; a thrown `ENOTFOUND` or `EAI_AGAIN`: «No encuentro {service}.»; a certificate code (as S32): «El certificado de {service} no es válido.»; a timeout: «{service} no ha respondido a tiempo.»; a `SyntaxError` (a body that is not JSON): «{service} ha contestado algo que no entiendo.»; anything else: «No llego a {service}: ¿hay conexión?» — with `detail` `HTTP <n>` or the code (from `err.cause.code` when it matches `^[A-Z0-9_]+$`, else the exception's name), and `fix: 'settings'` for 401, 403, 404, a host not found and a certificate code (the person fixes the token or the address), `fix: 'retry'` otherwise. No sentence contains a status number or an exception name. src/main/net-problem.test.ts each}

- {**W153** Any agent outside the list, or without a leading frontmatter, shall be left byte-for-byte as it was, and running the function a second time shall change nothing. scripts/libretto-models.test.ts other}

- {**W159** Wherever a workspace problem shows its fix — the workspace row, the new-work and start dialogs, the reopen bar and the sidebar — `fix: 'settings'` shall show «Abrir Ajustes» and open Ajustes, and `fix: 'git'` shall show «Instalar herramientas de Xcode» and run W70's install for git. src/renderer/newwork.test.ts settings}
- {**W157** When the person asks to remove a repo by id, Atril shall drop it from `repos.json` and leave its folder, its branches and its remembered Jira mapping untouched (a mapping to a removed id reads as no repo remembered); while a workspace of that repo is in the list it shall refuse with «{repo} tiene trabajos abiertos: ciérralos antes.», and while `workspaces.json` is damaged with W144's sentence; either refusal changes nothing. src/main/repos.test.ts removing}
- {**W158** When the person picks a new folder for a repo by id, Atril shall store the folder's git top level as that repo's path keeping its id and mode; it shall refuse with S13's sentence if the folder is not a git repository, and with «Esa carpeta ya es el repo {id}.» if another repo already has that path; either refusal, or a cancelled picker, changes nothing. src/main/repos.test.ts a}
- {**W160** When `atril:term:attach` is asked, main shall answer `{ ok: true }` once the tmux client started, `{ ok: false }` for an unknown or not-alive workspace, and, if starting the client throws, `{ error: «No he podido abrir la terminal de {branch}.», detail }` with the thrown message as `detail`, keeping no client for that workspace; it never rejects. src/main/pty.test.ts a}
- {**W161** When the terminal gets that error for the workspace it is showing, it shall show over the empty terminal a problem titled with the `error` field, «Tu agente sigue en tmux: solo falla esta vista.» under it and the detail folded; an answer for a workspace no longer shown is dropped. src/renderer/terminal.test.ts a}
- {**W162** «Volver a intentar» shall ask to attach again with the terminal's current size; on `{ ok: true }` the problem goes, and on another error it is replaced by the new one. src/renderer/terminal.test.ts retrying}
